description: The Statistical Institute of Jamaica posts housing tables from the 2011 Census of Population and Housing as one PDF per topic: housing units, dwellings and households by special area and by urban and rural area, housing unit type, material of outer walls, tenure, source of lighting, cooking fuel, rooms, source of water for domestic use, toilet facilities and garbage disposal. Coverage is national by parish; the water table, for example, counts 881,089 households, of which 438,014 had public water piped into the dwelling and 86,237 relied on private catchment, and it separates standpipes, trucked water and springs or rivers. The 2022 census pages add population and dwelling counts by community. Format and access: free PDF and web tables, no registration; the household questionnaire is posted beside them. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the 2011 tables are PDFs and mostly stop at parish level; the REDATAM server listed for Jamaica on the ECLAC directory did not answer from the cloud. Simulation uses: parish shares of catchment and trucked water for drought planning, wall materials for hurricane exposure, and lighting source for electricity access. Related records: the ECLAC REDATAM hub.

Household and individual questionnaires also posted.
